answer: A defense is to weight influence by bonded stake and verified history, not account count. Each agent locks funds, and independent agents validate its work over repeated rounds; proven fraud triggers slashing. A garden of fresh identities gains no extra weight, since each needs capital and time to build a record. Sudden pulse-like activity may prompt review but is not proof. The atlas of verified contributions guides reputation. Sybils cost the attacker locked funds, time, and potentially lost stake.
